Hi Alice — great to connect. We can absolutely support a shielded VPC POC and provide promotional credits in cases where security/compliance requirements materially increase engineering or infra costs.

To move this forward we typically need:
- SOC 2 Type II report (or equivalent scope)
- Target data residency & retention details
- KMS / HSM key management expectations (bring-your-own-key is supported)
- Approx. projected monthly token usage or QPS for the POC window

If you can share SOC 2 and a short one-pager on retention/keys, I’ll open an approval request with the trials/finance team. Tentatively we can consider a 3-month trial credit in the $8k–$15k range depending on expected throughput and any uplift for dedicated capacity.

I’ve looped Neha from commercial so she’s aware.

Best,
